notes.title: Mystery of Gevaudan at Steam Next Fest: February 2025
notes.notes:
Mystery of Gevaudan will be participating in Steam Next Fest: February 2025, so if you are yet to try the game’s demo, it’s the perfect time to do so! Also, feel free to leave feedback, it will help me a lot to make the game better.
Thank you, gamers!

notes.title: Game Development Progress #1: All visual assets created and imported
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that all visual assets (i.e. 3d models, textures and animations) I planned to create for the game have been successfully created and imported into the game. Also the general layout of the levels has been created.
The next step is to set up all events on each level.

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
Year 2024 has been a year of achieving important milestones: 
-the game got to final stages of alpha production 
-finally got its page on Steam as well as a page on Discord
-the original soundtrack was made for the game
-the demo has been released and later got its own page
Now as 2024 is already in the past, there are many more to achieve in 2025, such as: animations for last few characters, finishing sound and particle effects, implementing the remaining levels of the game. Also, Mystery of Gevaudan is going to participate in February's NextFest.
Hopefully, all of this will be achieved along with the release of the game in late June.
I wish you all only the best in 2025! Happy New Year!
Andrii 'Ashland Brom' Kapsamun

notes.title: The demo for Mystery of Gévaudan is available now - check it out
notes.notes:
The demo version of Mystery of Gévaudan is available on Steam and everyone can check it out. If you encounter a problem or want to provide feedback, you can do so via the link in the game's main menu (which will open a Google Form) or in the game's community centre on Steam, or in Discord.
The demo is a modified second level of the game, in which the protagonist finds himself trapped in an underground passageway. There is no way back, so you will have to go forward, trying to survive and overcoming obstacles, relying on your observation and ingenuity. It's worth noting that some effects have not been added to the game yet, and some elements may change in the release version of the game - also thanks to your feedback!
Enjoy the game!
